scope: Optional MediaQueryList API failure handling in an injected local object; not evidence of a current visitor-facing vulnerability.

finding.trigger: The addEventListener property getter throws before registration.
finding.fix: Move the modern-method existence check inside the existing setup try/catch; preserve partial-registration cleanup and legacy fallback.

regression.newCase: Modern method getter and optional modern cleanup getter throw; legacy listener registers, dispatches, removes exactly once, and ignores a retained callback after disposal.
